'''Putai''' also known as '''''Marghi West''''' is a nearly extinct [[Afro-Asiatic languages|Afro-Asiatic]] language spoken in northeastern [[Nigeria]].  The language is dying out and being replaced by [[Kanuri language|Kanuri]].<ref>{{Ethnologue17|mfl}}</ref>
